author.name: MARKTYAI YAPAYZEKA TEKNOLOJİLERİ VE YAZILIM ANONİM ŞİRKETİ

description: Markty is an AI marketing team for small businesses: a manager and department experts for social media, SEO and blog, e-commerce and email, working from your brand's research, voice and strategy. Ask for what you would ask a colleague: today's marketing brief, three Instagram posts about a launch, a blog outline, an image for a weekend sale, a check on how visible your brand is in AI answers, or to schedule a post. Everything Markty creates is saved to your Markty account, and nothing is published until you approve it in the Markty calendar. Requires a paid Markty plan. Each request to the team costs one Markty credit; images and other paid actions cost the same credits as in the Markty app, and reading your brand data is free.

defaultPrompt: Draft an Instagram post about your latest research.
What are some SEO/GEO gaps I should take care of?
